status: thresholds proposed, not contractual until measured

environment.required: isolated PostgreSQL matching the target package
environment.guard: session setting p79.bench_env='isolated' and stores count <= 20

scenarios.create: 1 order + 2 items, one statement per iteration (own transaction)
scenarios.import: 200 orders + 400 items in a single transaction

verdict_rules.PASS: median and p95 within budget, no deadlock, no lock timeout, backlog drained
verdict_rules.FAIL: any budget exceeded, any deadlock, or unexplained financial divergence
verdict_rules.NOT_COVERED: insufficient samples, missing lock instrumentation, or scenario not executed

known_limits: psql timing includes client/session overhead shared by both variants (differential measurement)
no per-trigger attribution without EXPLAIN instrumentation
worker is single-flight by design: parallel publication cannot be demonstrated
production runs PostgreSQL 17.6 ARM64 vs test 17.11 x86_64: results are not transferable as-is
